plan.title: Live RFQ Create New Version Confirmation

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ directly on the buyer's Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required live-event withdrawal configuration.
Click Create New Version while deliberately leaving its confirmation dialog unresolved, so the dialog behavior can be inspected.

args.text: Are you sure you want to create a new version?

steps.note: Assert that the expected confirmation window opens.
Assert that the confirmation offers Cancel.
Assert that the confirmation offers Create a New Version.
Assert that the event remains on the Responses route until a confirmation button is pressed.
